med.box.desc: Four even steps: in, hold, out, hold.
med.relax_478.name: 4-7-8 breathing
med.relax_478.desc: A slow rhythm with a long, gentle exhale.
med.coherent.name: Coherent breathing
med.coherent.desc: Smooth, even breaths in and out.
med.mindful.name: Guided mindfulness
med.mindful.desc: Short prompts to notice the moment.
med.pause.name: Mindful pause
med.mindful.p1: Notice how your body feels right now.
med.mindful.p2: Let your shoulders drop a little.
med.mindful.p3: Listen to the sounds around you.
med.mindful.p4: Feel your feet on the ground.
med.mindful.p5: If your mind wanders, gently come back.
med.mindful.p6: Follow your breath, one at a time.

med.pause.p2: Breathe in slowly, breathe out slowly.
med.pause.p3: One more breath. You are doing well.
